items.caption: Licensure of Large Retailers to Finance a Clean Energy Fund
items.question: Shall voters adopt ordinance imposing on large retailers a licensing requirement and 2% fee to finance a clean energy fund?

summary.text: If approved, the ordinance would require large retailers to get a license and pay a 2% fee on gross profits from retail sales in Eugene.

citations.quote: require large retailers to obtain a license and pay an annual 2% license fee on gross profits from retail sales within the City.

summary.text: The ordinance defines

citations.quote: large retailer

summary.text: If approved, the ordinance would place fee proceeds into a Eugene Clean Energy Fund for renewable energy, efficiency, programs, and job training.

citations.quote: dedicated to funding renewable energy and energy efficiency programs; clean energy job training, apprenticeships, and contractor support;

summary.text: An expert committee would be required to recommend fund use, evaluate effectiveness, and ensure work is done by historically disadvantaged groups.

citations.quote: require an expert committee to recommend use of funds, evaluate effectiveness of fund, and ensure work funded is is performed by historically disadvantaged groups.
